structure: a giant smartphone standing upright like a tower in the centre of a portrait canvas, its screen cut away to reveal stacked floors inside, with the camera notch at the top.
character: young social media intern (a Black woman in her early 20s, long braids, coral top, lanyard)
scenes: she arrives with a coffee and checks her phone while abstract chat bubbles and heart shapes float up from it.
she scrolls a tablet of abstract video thumbnails, a magnifying glass beside her, a rising trend line on a wall screen.
she films a short video on a phone mounted on a ring-light tripod while a colleague holds up a product.
she sits at a laptop showing a calendar grid of small colourful square thumbnails, arranging them.
she studies a screen with a bar chart while bookmark and share-arrow icons rise from it; dusk through the window.
props: hearts, chat bubbles, bookmark icons, share arrows, a ring light, a camera, a play button, notification bells, a winding cable
